follow100Note: Membership fees were only $1.92 of every $100 of revenue, yet they covered about 51% of Costco's operating profit — the membership model, not the markup, is where the money is.

segments.name: Membership fees
segments.note: Annual fees from members — almost pure profit, since the warehouses would run anyway.

takeaways.text: Comparable sales rose 6.6% — U.S. +6.2%, Canada +7.7% and other international +7.7% — or 6.5% after adjusting for fuel prices and currency, with a small extra boost from the shift of the fiscal calendar.
takeaways.title: Shoppers kept coming

takeaways.text: Membership fees rose 7.6% to $1.12B. They are just 1.9% of revenue, yet they alone cover 51% of the quarter's $2.2B in operating income.
takeaways.title: Membership is the profit engine

takeaways.text: E-commerce comparable sales jumped 20.7%, and Costco ended the quarter with 878 warehouses, including 605 in the United States and Puerto Rico.
takeaways.title: Online is catching up

verdict: Costco's net sales rose 9.1% to $57.4B as comparable sales grew 6.6%, and with $1.12B of nearly cost-free membership fees on top, profit jumped 29% to $1.68B — though last year's quarter carried a one-off $298M shipping charge that flatters the comparison.
